violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW SHELL EGGS STORED ABOVE PASTEURIZED EGGS AND OTHER READY TO EAT FOODS IN CONTINENTAL 2 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR/FREEZER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EMPLOYEE REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Food from Approved Source
violations.observation: The following food item(s) is not from an approved food preparation/processing facility: PREPACKAGED MEALS - IRISH BEEF AND POTATOES, TURKEY AND WHITE BEANS ORDERED FROM FACTOR 75 FOR WHICH NO CONFIRMATION OF REGULATORY PERMITTING WAS AVAILABLE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be obtained from sources that comply with the Law. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO OBTAIN COPY OF REGULATORY PERMIT OR LAST FOOD PERMIT INSPECTION REPORT OR DISCONTINUE USE OF FOOD SUPPLIED BY FACTOR 75 FOR SERVICE TO RESIDENTS/CLIENTS. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO OBTAIN PREPARED MEALS FROM APPROVED SUPPLIERS OR FOODS FROM APPROVED SOURCES TO BE USED IN PREPARATION OF MEALS FOR RESIDENTS/CLIENTS AT THE ESTABLISHMENT. PLEASE EMAIL EHS ONCE REGULATORY PERMIT HAS BEEN PROVIDED FOR FACTOR 75.
